data_quality.basis: Company filings, earnings releases and press releases (2024–2026)
data_quality.notes: Phase and CAPEX data verified against latest available sources as of 2026-05-14. Comprehensive gap fill conducted 2026-05-10/14. NEW ADDITIONS: Whiptail (corrected Pre-FEED→Execution, FID Apr 2024, $12.7B), Uaru (Execution, 5th Stabroek), Gato do Mato (Shell Brazil, FID Mar 2025), P-91/Búzios12 + P-88/Albacora (FEED tender), Azule Agogo Angola (Production Jul 2025), Johan Castberg (Production Mar 2025), Zuluf (Saudi Aramco Execution), QatarEnergy NFE ($28.75B) + NFS ($10B) Execution, ADNOC Upper Zakum Execution, Aphrodite FEED, Leviathan Expansion (FID Jan 2026), Woodside Scarborough/Pluto T2 ($12.5B Execution), bp Tangguh UCC (FID Nov 2024), Eni Indonesia dual-FID South+North Hub (Mar 2026), INPEX Masela/Abadi FEED. ROOT CAUSE OF GAPS: (1) original data biased toward IOC deepwater FID press-releases; missed NOC programs (QatarEnergy, ADNOC), rolling FPSO batches (Petrobras), LNG megaprojects, and FIDs before data was first compiled. FIXES: Búzios phase numbers corrected (P-80=Phase8, P-81=Phase9, P-82=Phase10, P-83=Phase11); SEAP I fid_date corrected to Apr 2026; Hammerhead corrected to 7th Stabroek. 2026-05-29 REVIEW: petrobras-sepia-1 removed (5yr production threshold). No new FIDs or major changes since 2026-05-14. Venus/Wisting/Papua LNG/Aphrodite/Masela remain FEED. Búzios 6 H1 2026 first oil on track but not officially confirmed — remains Execution. 2026-05-29: adnoc-upper-zakum 제거 (인공섬 기반, MODU 수요 無). Gallaf + Maydan Mazam 추가 (Shallow Offshore Fixed Platform 스코프 확장).

projects.notes: Semi-sub FPS; 75k boe/d peak. Chevron 62.5% (op), TotalEnergies 37.5%.
Alaminos Canyon Block 773, ~2,620m WD. First oil January 9, 2025 — ahead of schedule. Semi-sub TLP; ~100k boe/d peak. Shell 60% (op), Chevron 40%.
Argos FPS; 140k bbl/d. bp 60.5% (op), BHP 23.9%, Union Oil 15.6%.

Mississippi Canyon Block 607, ~2,000m WD, 120km off Louisiana coast. First oil achieved April 2025. Subsea tieback to Blind Faith semi-FPS (~75k bbl/d plateau). Chevron 60% (op), TotalEnergies 40%. CAPEX ~$1.6B (tieback, not FPSO).
Keathley Canyon, ~1,800m WD. bp 100% (op). FID taken July 2024. CAPEX ~$5B. First production targeted 2029. Semi-sub hub concept.

Offshore Guyana (Stabroek Block). One Guyana FPSO; ~250k bbl/d peak. First oil August 8, 2025 — 4 months ahead of schedule. ExxonMobil 45% (op), Chevron 30% (ex-Hess, 2025-07 인수), CNOOC 25%. Brings total Stabroek capacity to ~900k bopd.
Offshore Guyana (Stabroek Block). 7th FPSO development. FID taken September 2025. CAPEX ~$6.8B confirmed. MODEC FPSO; ~150k bbl/d. ExxonMobil 45% (op), Chevron (ex-Hess) 30%, CNOOC 25%.

Offshore Guyana (Stabroek Block). 6th FPSO development; targets Whiptail, Pinktail and Tilapia fields. FID April 2024. FPSO Jaguar (SBM Offshore); ~250k bbl/d. CAPEX ~$12.7B gross. First oil 2027. ExxonMobil 45% (op), Chevron (ex-Hess) 30%, CNOOC 25%.

Offshore Guyana (Stabroek Block). 5th FPSO development; ~250k bbl/d. FPSO 이름: Errea Wittu. FID April 27, 2023. First oil targeted 2026. 2026-02 mooring pre-installation 완료. ExxonMobil 45% (op), Chevron (ex-Hess) 30%, CNOOC 25%. CAPEX indicative (~$10B based on peer project comparison).
P-78. 8th FPSO for Búzios field (6번째 Petrobras 소유 Búzios FPSO). Pre-salt Santos Basin. First oil Dec 31, 2025. 180k bbl/d. Petrobras 100% (op).
FPSO P-79; 7th FPSO for Búzios field, pre-salt Santos Basin. First oil achieved May 2026. Petrobras 100% (op) in transfer-of-rights area.

Libra/Mero field, pre-salt Santos Basin (~2,000m WD). FPSO Alexandre de Gusmão; first oil May 2025. 4th FPSO of Mero development; ~180k bbl/d. Petrobras 38.6% (op), Shell 19.3%, TotalEnergies 19.3%, CNOOC 9.65%, CNPC 9.65%, Petrogal 3.5%.
Pre-salt Santos Basin. FPSO P-80; Keppel hull contract awarded July 2022. First oil targeted 2027. CAPEX indicative (~$3–4B). Petrobras 100% (op) in transfer-of-rights area.
Pre-salt Santos Basin. 9th Búzios FPSO slot. P-81은 2026-04 SEAP I(Sergipe)로 재지정됨 → Búzios Phase 9 P-번호 미확정. Petrobras 공식 확인 필요. 2027 목표는 변경 가능. Petrobras 100% (op).
Pre-salt Santos Basin. FPSO P-82; Seatrium hull contract. First oil targeted 2027. CAPEX indicative (~$3–4B). Petrobras 100% (op).
Pre-salt Santos Basin. FPSO P-83; Keppel hull contract. First oil targeted 2027–2028. CAPEX indicative (~$3–4B). Petrobras 100% (op).

Pre-salt Santos Basin. FID May 2024. FPSO P-84; Seatrium contract ($8.16B combined for P-84 + P-85). ~100k bbl/d peak. First oil 2029. Petrobras 65.7% (op), Shell 16.7%, TotalEnergies 15%, Petrogal 1.7%.

Pre-salt Santos Basin. FID May 2024. FPSO P-85; Seatrium contract ($8.16B combined for P-84/Atapu + P-85). ~100k bbl/d peak. First oil 2029. Petrobras 55.3% (op), TotalEnergies 16.9%, QatarEnergy 12.7%, PETRONAS 12.7%, Petrogal 2.4%.

Sergipe-Alagoas Basin. FID April 14, 2026 (Module 1). FPSO P-81; SBM Offshore L&O 계약. Part of $12B two-FPSO SEAP development (P-81 + P-87). First oil 2031 (post-2030 Business Plan horizon). Petrobras 100% (op).
Sergipe-Alagoas Basin. FID December 30, 2025 (Module 2 — SEAP II가 SEAP I보다 먼저 FID). FPSO P-87; SBM Offshore L&O 계약. First oil 2030. Petrobras 100% (op).

Mauritania/Senegal maritime border. First gas Dec 31, 2024; first LNG cargo (FLNG Gimi) Jan 23, 2025; COD reached June 2025. Producing above 2.7 Mtpa nameplate capacity. bp 56% (op), Kosmos 27%, PETROSEN/SMHPM 17%.

Orange Basin, offshore Namibia, Block 2913B (~3,000m WD). One of the largest deepwater discoveries of the past decade (~6 Bboe potential). TotalEnergies 40% (op), QatarEnergy 30%, Impact Oil & Gas 20%, NAMCOR 10%. FPSO concept; requires UDW drillship for appraisal/development. FID targeting late 2026; first production 2029–2030. CAPEX $16B+ indicative.

Orange Basin, offshore Namibia, PEL 39 (~2,000–3,000m WD). Shell 45% (op), QatarEnergy 45%, NAMCOR 10%. Jan 2025: Shell $400M write-down 발표 — 일부 유정 "상업성 없음(not commercially viable)" 판단. 2025년 시추 캠페인 일시 중단. 개발 컨셉 및 FID 타임라인 불확실. 잠재 FID 2026, first oil 2030+ (단, 상업성 재검토 완료 후).

Offshore Nigeria, OML 118 (~1,000m WD). FID taken December 2024. Subsea tie-back to existing Bonga Main FPSO. FID 시점: Shell 55% (op), ExxonMobil 20%, ENI (Agip) 12.5%, TotalEnergies 12.5%. TotalEnergies 완전 매각(2025-12, $510M): Shell 10% 인수(ENI 2.5% pre-emption 행사). 현재: Shell 65% (op), ENI 15%, ExxonMobil 20%. Peak ~110k bbl/d.
UK North Sea, uHPHT gas condensate. Subsea tie-back to Shearwater hub; ~40k boepd. Shell 100% (op). Topside installed October 2025; first gas targeted Q3–Q4 2026. 2026-03 OPRED 추가 기술정보 요청(규제 리스크 잔존).
West of Shetland. bp 45.1% (op). Concept selection stage; long lead-time development.

Norwegian Barents Sea, northernmost NCS oil discovery (~300m WD). Equinor 35% (op), TotalEnergies 35%, Petoro 20%, INPEX Idemitsu 10%. CAPEX ~NOK 104B (~$10.2B USD). Arctic-rated power-from-shore FPSO concept. FID target end-2026 (repeatedly deferred from 2022); first production 2031. Early-works agreement with SLB signed May 2024.
UK North Sea, Block 211/13a (~150m WD, HE). Shell 50% (op), NEO Energy 50%. First oil February 2025. New-build HE FPSO replacing ageing infrastructure.

Offshore Abu Dhabi sour gas megaproject. ~1.5 Bcf/d. Partner 변경 이력: Wintershall Dea→PTTEP(Jun 2024), Eni 25%→10% (ADNOC 55%→70% Apr 2024), OMV→Lukoil(2023)→ADNOC(Nov 2025 sanctions). 현재 파트너: ADNOC ~80% (op), ENI 10%, PTTEP 10%.
Arabian Gulf offshore. +300k bbl/d capacity increment. Marjan first production commenced December 2025 (동시에 Tanajib Gas Plant 가동). Saudi Aramco 100%.
Arabian Gulf offshore. +250k bbl/d increment. Saudi Aramco 100%.

Offshore Suriname, 100–1,000m WD. FID taken October 1, 2024 (GranMorgu development: Sapakara + Krabdagu fields). TotalEnergies 50% (op), APA Corp 50% (Staatsolie holds option for up to 20%). FPSO by SBM Offshore; 220k bbl/d capacity. FPSO hull delivered February 2025.

Offshore Sarawak, Malaysia, Block SK316 (~200km offshore). Largest offshore gas field in Malaysia; ~10 TCF resource. First gas August 2024 at initial 200 MMscfd; nameplate ~545 MMscfd. PETRONAS Carigali 90% (op), Exploration and Production Malaysia Venture 10%.
Offshore Western Australia. Gas tied back to Prelude FLNG. Shell 82% (op).
Papua New Guinea. TotalEnergies 37.55% (op), ExxonMobil 37.04%, Santos 22.83%, JX Nippon 2.58%. ~5.6 Mtpa LNG. FID target mid-2026 (delayed from 2025; cost/contract structure 논의 중).
Papua New Guinea. Potential 3rd LNG train. Contingent on Papua LNG FID and gas supply agreements.

Area 1, Cabo Delgado Province. FID 2019; force majeure declared April 2021 (security situation). Force majeure lifted November 2025; full construction restart January 2026 (~42% complete). CAPEX revised to ~$20.5B (+$4.5B cost overrun). First LNG targeted H1 2029. ~13 Mtpa at full build-out. TotalEnergies 26.5% (op), Mitsui 20%, ENH (state) 15%, ONGC Videsh 10%, BPRL/Bharat 10%, Beas Rovuma (Oil India) 10%, PTTEP 8.5%.

Pre-salt Santos Basin, ~2,100m WD. FID March 2025. MODEC FPSO on 20-yr charter; TechnipFMC iEPCI subsea (>$1B contract). FPSO capacity 120k bbl/d. Total CAPEX ~$3.4B market estimate (not officially disclosed). Shell 50% (op), Ecopetrol 30%, TotalEnergies 20%. First oil 2029.

Pre-salt Santos Basin. 12th FPSO at Búzios field; 180k bbl/d. Designed as strategic gas hub — processes own production + exports gas from neighbouring platforms. BOT model; tender launched Oct 2025, proposals submitted ~Apr 2026, award pending. Petrobras 88.99% (op), CNOOC 7.34%, CNPC 3.67%. CAPEX indicative (~$4B).

Campos Basin. FPSO P-88; 120k bbl/d. BOT model; 7.5-yr operating period before transfer. Tender proposals due May 25, 2026 (extended). 8 pre-qualified bidders: MODEC, SBM Offshore, BW Offshore, Yinson, MISC, Shapoorji, Ocyan, Altera/Ocyan JV. Award expected H2 2026; operations post-2030. CAPEX indicative. Note: P-86 Marlim tender was cancelled Aug 2025.

Block 15/06, offshore Angola (~1,500m WD). Largest global FID of 2023. Two FPSOs: Agogo FPSO (first oil Jul 29, 2025) + Ndungu FPSO (startup Feb 2026). Combined peak ~175k bbl/d. Azule Energy 36.84% (op; bp/Eni 50/50 JV), Sonangol E&P 36.84%, Sinopec 26.32%.

Norwegian Barents Sea (~380m WD). First oil March 31, 2025; plateau ~220k bopd reached June 2025. 450–650 MMbbl recoverable. FPSO Johan Castberg. Equinor 46.3% (op), Vår Energi 30%, Petoro 23.7%. Isflak tieback FID taken Dec 2025 (~14–24 MMbbl, startup Q4 2028).

Arabian Gulf offshore. 600k bbl/d capacity increment from new central processing platform. Four major EPCI packages awarded (McDermott, Larsen & Toubro among contractors). Saudi Aramco 100%. First production revised to 2027 following 2023 production-ceiling rollback. CAPEX ~$5B based on contract disclosures; total project scope may exceed.

North Field, Qatar (world's largest single non-associated gas field). 4 LNG trains × 8 Mtpa = 32 Mtpa increment. First train commissioning mid-2026; full 4-train completion mid-2028 (이란 분쟁으로 공사 중단 2026-02~05; 2027→2028로 연기). Raises Qatar LNG capacity 77 → 126 Mtpa combined with NFS. Partners: QatarEnergy 72.5%, TotalEnergies 6.25%, Shell 6.25%, ExxonMobil 6.25%, ConocoPhillips 3.125%, Eni 3.125%, Sinopec 1.25%, CNPC 1.25%.

North Field, Qatar. 2 LNG trains × 8 Mtpa = 16 Mtpa increment. Completes Qatar North Field expansion. QatarEnergy 75% (op), TotalEnergies 9.375%, Shell 9.375%, ConocoPhillips 6.25%. CAPEX ~$10B. First LNG 2027–2028.

Block 12, offshore Cyprus, Eastern Mediterranean (~1,700m WD). FEED commenced December 2025; FEED budget ~$111M; FID targeted 2027 after FEED completion end-2026. 4 wells tied to FPU (~800 MMcf/d). Estimated CAPEX ~$4B. Chevron Cyprus (op), Shell (BG Cyprus), NewMed Energy. First gas early 2030s.

Offshore Israel, Eastern Mediterranean (~1,700m WD). FID January 16, 2026. Adds 3 wells + subsea infrastructure; raises delivery capacity to ~21 BCM/yr. CAPEX $2.36B. First gas H2 2029. Chevron 39.66% (op, via Chevron Mediterranean Ltd), NewMed Energy 45.34%, Ratio Energies 15%.

Offshore Western Australia (~900m WD). ~96% complete as of Q1 2026 (Mar 2026); FPU arrived Jan 2026. First LNG targeted Q4 2026. Pluto Train 2 ~5 Mtpa + up to 3 Mtpa through existing Train 1. Woodside 73.5% upstream (op), BHP 26.5% upstream; Woodside 51%, GIP 49% for Train 2. Revised total CAPEX ~$12.5B gross.

Berau Basin, Papua Barat, Indonesia. FID November 2024. Ubadari field development + Indonesia's first at-scale CCUS (~15 Mt CO2 sequestration capacity) + onshore compression. Saipem main EPC contractor (Nov 2024 award). First production 2028. bp 40.22% (op), MI Berau 16.30%, CNOOC Muturi 13.90%, Nippon Oil, Talisman, KG Berau/Wiriagar.

Kutei Basin, East Kalimantan (1,000–1,800m WD). Dual FID with North Hub on March 18, 2026. South Hub: ~1 Bcf/d gas + condensate; ties back to existing Jangkrik FPU. Combined $15B total for South + North Hub. First production 2028. Eni (op), Pertamina. Combined resource base ~10 TCF.

Kutei Basin, East Kalimantan (1,700–2,000m WD). Dual FID with South Hub on March 18, 2026. North Hub: ~1 Bcf/d gas; requires new FPSO (~1 MMbbl storage, >1 Bcf/d processing). First production 2028–2029. Eni (op), Pertamina.

Masela Block, Arafura Sea, Indonesia (~800m WD). ~9.5 Mtpa LNG. JGC awarded FEED contract August 2025. FID targeted 2027–2028 if FEED completes on schedule. CAPEX ~$20B estimate. INPEX Masela 65% (op), Pertamina Hulu Energi, PETRONAS Masela.

Al-Shaheen oilfield, offshore Qatar, ~100m WD. Operator: North Oil Company (QatarEnergy + TotalEnergies JV). Multi-batch fixed platform expansion: 8 wellhead platforms (up to 19,000t). Batch 3 first oil Dec 2024; central processing platform installation ongoing late 2025. CAPEX ~$5B (indicative). Jackup 수요 지속.

120km offshore Abu Dhabi, Arabian Gulf. Fixed platform 재개발. EPC tender 발행 2025-02, 주요 입찰사: McDermott·Saipem·NPCC·L&T·Technip·Petrofac. 공급망 이슈·지정학적 긴장으로 지연. FID 2025–2026 예상. CAPEX $4–5B (추정). 잭업 리그 수요.
